ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent it.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for greater accountability in the Medicaid system. By analyzing data and conducting interviews with experts, we can shed light on the scope of the problem and the efforts being made to address it.
